newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ROMA'S MORIERO REPORTED HEADING TO EVERTON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMA'S MORIERO REPORTED HEADING TO EVERTON.

text.p: Roma's Italian midfielder Francesco Moriero looks set to join English premier league club Everton as a replacement for Russian Andrei Kanchelskis, the Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper said on Tuesday.
The paper reported that Everton had agreed a deal with Moriero's agent and the player had been given a week to consider terms. His contract with Roma expires at the end of the season.
"Mission accomplished. Francesco Moriero has been virtually signed by Everton," the newspaper said.
It said his agent Vincenzo d'Ippolito had finalised details over the weekend with Everton officials for a four-year contract worth some 1.4 billion lire ($840,000) a season.
"The decision seems more or less taken. Moriero will therefore leave Roma at the end of the season," the paper said.
A former Italy under-21 player, Moriero joined Roma in 1994 after two seasons at Cagliari. Before that he had played with his home town Lecce in serie A and B.
Kanchelskis joined Fiorentina, Roma's next league opponents this weekend, from Everton in January.
